caption: The drawing features a single transparent, clear glass object that appears to be a chimney or shade for a lamp. It is centrally positioned on a plain, off-white or beige background. The object is elongated with a wider base and top, and it gently narrows in the middle, giving it a curved, hourglass-like contour. The outline is rendered in fine black or dark gray pencil lines, with some subtle internal lines suggesting the translucency and cylindrical form of the glass. There is minimal shading, and no color is used in the object other than the basic grayscale of the pencil. The bottom left corner of the page contains a small, horizontal scale, and the bottom right shows a signature or label in similar pencil marking.
title: Hurricane Shade
